name: Crewe to Birmingham International
description: Scrollable Up and Down WCML track diagram from Crewe to Birmingham International via Stafford, Wolverhampton and Birmingham New Street.
credits: Train descriptions and service running information from Signal Maps and Network Rail. Reporting locations from Network Rail SMART via VailData. Crewe signal mappings from the Trainly TD SOP tables. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Birmingham signal indications use EASMData (GPLv3). Station codes from the Office of Rail and Road.
